author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Clayface was a much-needed box office win for Warner Bros. and DC Studios. The horror movie based on the DC character brought in around $43 million worldwide, enough for the top spot at the weekend box office. The modest budget of around $40 million also helped the movie's bottom line. In other news, composer Austin Wintory revealed he was in talks with BioWare to create music the now-canceled Mass Effect 5. He has shared drafts of music for the game online. And we take a peek at the five immersive worlds of the all-new Universal Epic Universe, and one of its featured attractions – Stardust Racers, all at Universal Orlando Resort.
title: Clayface Puts James Gunn's DCU Back on Track With #1 Box Office Debut - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
BioWare doesn’t need a eulogy: as private equity and corporate consolidation shutters yet another legendary creative institution, the social media has naturally flooded with obituaries for the studio behind Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. But you cannot kill BioWare by filing some legal paperwork: it is the foundational DNA of modern interactive storytelling, and massively influential in the wider world of culture, seeping into everything from Star Trek to The Expanse. BioWare has attained a level of mortality that most storytellers can only dream of: by outliving its corporate shell and quietly conquering an entire medium.

BioWare's design philosophy continues to drive the biggest RPGs, and more besides. Its spiritual successors include Archetype Entertainment’s sci-fi epic Exodus (helmed by Drew Karpyshyn and James Ohlen), Casey Hudson’s Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic at Arcanaut Studios, Mike Laidlaw’s Eternal Strands, and David Gaider’s S
title: BioWare Can Never Die: It’s Everywhere You Look

author: IGN
description:
Every kid needs someone in their corner. Check out the trailer for Way of the Warrior Kid, an upcoming coming-of-age drama movie starring Chris Pratt, Jocko Willink, Jude Hill, Linda Cardellini, and Levi McConaughey. 

Middle school has been a nightmare for Marc, a good kid who is bullied and feels behind in everything. That changes when his Uncle Jake, an injured and decorated Navy SEAL, comes to spend the summer. To help Marc defend himself, Jake devises an ambitious program called "Operation Warrior Kid" based on his SEAL training to teach his nephew what real courage is and how to face down his own demons.

Way of the Warrior Kid is produced by David Ellison, Dana Goldberg, Don Granger, McG, Mary Viola, Chris Pratt, Ben Everard, Jocko Willink, and Bruce Wayne Gillies.

Will Staples, Steven Bello, and Cliff Lanning serve as executive producers. It is written by Will Staples.

Way of the Warrior Kid, directed by McG, premieres on Apple TV on November 25, 2026.
title: Way of the Warrior Kid - Official Trailer (2026) Chris Pratt, Jocko Willink, Linda Cardellini

author: IGN
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign and multiplayer review by Simon Cardy.

An all-action campaign full of twists and turns, MW4's single-player shines, but the multiplayer portion of Modern Warfare 4 is quite a bit duller. Solid foundations and a novel new arena ensure there’s plenty of fun to be had, but the majority of its new modes and maps do little to excite due to some unimaginative design choices and awkward spawn positions. The combination of these two halves is a much-needed reminder of what Call of Duty can be at its best, even if it can’t fully recapture the heights of its glory days.

#IGN #CallOfDuty #ModernWarfare4MultiplayerReview
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Review (Campaign and Multiplayer)
